periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree upward-outward tilt relative to the horizontal axis of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high width-to-height ratio along the primary diagonal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the lateral cheek region, with the centroid shifted toward the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant; the visible portion of the dark transverse band covers roughly 40-50% of the visible upper torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Symmetrically rounded curvature at the superior margin of the visible ear.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced sagittal crest-like tuft of fur visible at the top of the cranium and high-volume ventral neck fur.
